item.title: Sen. Rebecca Saldaña Is Running for King County Council District 2
item.description: It’s Not a Demotion by Nathalie Graham King County Executive Girmay Zahilay’s county council seat has barely cooled, and next year’s election is already on. Washington State Sen. Rebecca Saldaña (D-Seattle) announced—first at a private event Sunday, then officially on Monday—that she’s running. The seat will be wide open in the November election because Zahilay only considered appointees who would “care take” the position, not seek election for the seat.
